name: Lelisu LS-253 Wireless Headphones | Bluetooth Over-Ear Headset with Type-C Charging
description:
Experience high-quality audio and all-day comfort with the Lelisu LS-253 Wireless Headphones. Featuring Bluetooth connectivity, these headphones pair effortlessly with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other compatible devices. Enjoy clear stereo sound, deep bass, and crisp treble for music, gaming, movies, and calls. The cushioned over-ear design ensures comfort during long sessions, while Type-C fast charging provides quick power-ups and extended battery life. A built-in microphone allows hands-free calling and voice assistant support for versatile use.
Key Features
 Bluetooth connectivity for stable, fast pairing
 Type-C fast charging for extended playtime
 Clear stereo sound with deep bass and crisp treble
 Comfortable over-ear cushioned design for long wear
 Built-in microphone for hands-free calls and voice commands
 Long battery life for uninterrupted entertainment
 Universal compatibility with Android, iOS, Windows, and other devices
How to Use
 Turn on Bluetooth on your device and headset
 Pair headset with smartphone, tablet, or laptop
 Adjust headband and ear pads for comfort
 Use controls for music, calls, and voice assistant functions
Material
ABS Plastic, Synthetic Leather, Foam Cushions
Safety Information
 Avoid exposure to water or excessive moisture
 Do not drop or apply strong impact
 Keep out of reach of children
 Use at moderate volume to protect hearing
Package Includes
 1 × Lelisu LS-253 Wireless Headphones
 1 × Type-C Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
